name: CQRS & Event Sourcing Architecture Profile
description: Defines strict separation between Command (mutation) models, Read (query) projections, and immutable Event Streams.

layers.name: CommandSide
layers.description: Validates business invariants and writes state deltas exclusively to the append-only Event Store.

layers.name: EventStore
layers.description: Immutable append-only ledger of domain events.

layers.name: ReadProjections
layers.description: Asynchronously projects immutable domain events into query-optimized read databases.
